finalState: The Summit Drive break is isolated; repair, flushing and sampling follow before the main returns to service.

The Boil Water Advisory and two-hour sampling continue; the earliest lift is Thursday.

fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your radios. Ten minutes, then the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three that did not
hotWashQuestions: How long did it take to call it a main break, and what told you?
How did you decide the advisory area without pressure data?
Who understood that the Mill Road booster would pull down Zone 1, and when?
Why did one power supply take out five sites, and what should change?
What did the hospital and the dialysis patients hear from you, and when?

snapshot.title: ENDEX: Incident Resolution — Boil Water Advisory Maintained

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The Boil Water Advisory for Zone 2 remains in effect. The control system remains isolated per CISA and FBI guidance. The Northgate Booster Station (RTU-03) is under manual supervision, with BP-301/302/303 in manual mode and no remote access. The missing 03/2025 revision for PLC-02 has been formally reported to the Ohio EPA DDAGW. All recovery actions are complete. The hot wash will begin now.
finalState: The Boil Water Advisory for Zone 2 remains active.
The control system is isolated; no remote access to RTU-03 or PLC-02.
The Northgate Booster Station is in manual mode with no remote control.
The missing PLC-02 backup revision has been reported to Ohio EPA DDAGW.
All recovery actions are logged on Form ERP-2.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: What were the key indicators that the loss of telemetry led to an incorrect assumption about system integrity?
How did the team balance the need for manual operations against the risk of human error during the pressure surge?
What steps were taken to ensure the advisory was issued only after confirming both pressure loss and loss of disinfection?
How did the absence of the PLC-02 backup impact confidence in system recovery?
What would have changed if the Northgate Booster Station had not tripped due to surge, and how might that have affected Zone 2’s pressure recovery?
